en: The definition of the sixty-four *daṇḍas* is as follows: the number of breaths (*prāṇa*) in half a day is five thousand four hundred (5,400). Thus, by calculation, one should know that in a full day and night there are twenty-one thousand six hundred breaths; specifically, in one *ghaṭī* there are three hundred and sixty breaths. This concludes the classification of the sixty-four *daṇḍas*.
